R623.note: Matches the case exactly: bounds check against MAX_FIELDS before array access.

R629.note: shared_ptr prevents the immediate crash, but the case's own established fix shape for this pattern is weak_ptr+lock() (observer lifetime owned externally); with shared_ptr the bus now keeps every subscribed observer alive forever since no unsubscribe path is added, changing the ownership model rather than matching the intended shape.

R630.note: Argument-list subprocess call plus filename allowlist closes the shell injection; the fixed UPLOAD_DIR prefix on input_path also prevents leading-dash flag injection.
